name: Rosemary-Parmesan Crusted Chicken with Olive, Pine Nut & Arugula Salad
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional). Coat with a thin layer of oil.
Finely grate Parmesan and place in a medium bowl.
Add bread crumbs and spices to the bowl with the Parmesan; stir to combine the coating.
Crack eggs into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Sprinkle flour over both sides to coat.
Dip chicken cutlets, one at a time, into the egg; shake off excess, then dredge in the bread crumb coating, pressing to adhere. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until the chicken is golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Using a clean cutting board, slice one lemon into wedges and set aside for serving. Juice remaining lemon into a clean medium bowl.
Add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, halve, and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, peel, halve, and thinly slice carrots crosswise into half-moons; add to the bowl.
Halve olives; add to the bowl along with the arugula and pine nuts. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Squeeze lemon over the chicken and enjoy!
author: Mealime
